bio: In this stylish eatery with a bar and an open kitchen, you’ll find the eponymous artisanal French salt on each table – but you won’t need it thanks to the owner-chef’s spot-on sense of seasoning. At this ‘bistro de luxe’ he delivers classical French cuisine with a light, modern spin – making it easy to save room for his signature Baba. Two set menus - we recommend the tasting menu for a global experience....
